Use fake location only for testing and privacy, never to deceive others.

Android lets one app, chosen in Developer options as “mock location app”, replace the position that other apps receive. Able registers test providers (GPS, network and fused where allowed) and, when Google Play services accept it, also feeds their fused location.\n\nNothing is changed permanently: stopping removes the test providers and apps get the real location again at their next update. To revoke access, choose “Nothing” under Select mock location app.

Android marks every simulated location as mock, and apps can check which app is the mock location app. Banking, ride-sharing, delivery, dating, games and work apps often detect it and may refuse to work, flag or suspend your account. Some apps keep using a cached real position until their next update.

Fake GPS is meant for testing apps, demos and protecting your privacy. Do not use it to deceive other people or services, cheat in games, falsify work attendance or evade restrictions: it may break terms of service or the law. Emergency calls may still use your real location.
